name: Andrew Leick
headline: Electrical Engineering student at Stanford University
summary: Seeking software development roles. Two summers as a Software Development Engineer Intern at Amazon, building systems on AWS.
about: I’m an Electrical Engineering student at Stanford, graduating in 2028. I got into engineering through FIRST Robotics in high school, where wiring, coding and leading my robotics team turned into the thing I most wanted to keep doing.

What I enjoy most is building tools that make other engineers’ days easier. At Amazon that meant turning up to an hour of digging through logs into a single search for on-call engineers, and then handing that same search to AI agents through an MCP server.
And yes, this site makes you choose a starter. Everything I’ve built lives in the Pokédex up top. If something there catches your eye, I’d love to talk about it.
currently: Taking Operating Systems Principles at Stanford, and adding personality to this site.
availability: Open to software engineering internships for summer 2027.
contactBlurb: The best way to reach me is by email.
